children: Halliburton Co. (HAL) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 15, 2026.

On October 15, 2026, Halliburton issued a press release announcing the appointment of David C. Hernandez to its Board, a copy of which is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated by reference herein.

The information furnished pursuant to this Item 7.01, including Exhibit 99.1, shall not be deemed to be "filed" for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall such information be deemed incorporated by reference into any registration statement or other filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, unless specifically identified in such filing as being incorporated by reference in such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/45012/000004501226000069/hal-20261015.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/45012/000004501226000069/0000045012-26-000069-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
